corrections.limitation: The dataset's per-fund CSV was not retrievable through the current web reader because it serves text/csv. The JSON metadata and methodology page were retrieved; the exact per-fund Nov 2 rows were not independently parsed.

exclusions.reason: Issuer page capture gap from 2026-09-02 to 2026-09-28; four-week catch-up would distort day-by-day flows.
exclusions.treatment: GXRP holdings and AUM remain in total holdings/AUM, but GXRP flow is withheld (flow_status=excluded) across the history.

corrections.limitation: The -32,825 XRP is not a complete seven-fund flow. The dataset sums computed per-fund holdings changes; initial and excluded rows contribute nothing.

cryptoetf.reported_detail: XRPC -$0.5M; XRPZ and GXRP not reported; Bitwise XRP and TOXR zero.
cryptoetf.methodology: Fund share creations/redemptions at NAV; not ETF trading volume.

xrp_insights.universe: Six US spot XRP ETFs plus BITW
xrp_insights.methodology: Day-over-day change in issuer-reported XRP holdings; changes can include non-creation/redemption effects such as BITW index rebalancing and XRP-denominated fee accruals; GXRP flow excluded.

corrections.interpretation: Different fund universe, data completeness, publication time and calculation method. The values are not a like-for-like contradiction and must not be averaged.

corrected_feature_rules: Store XRP Insights Nov 2 as settled for its available computed flows as of 2026-11-03T12:19:10.322Z; do not label it provisional after this capture.
Keep GXRP holdings/AUM in totals but mark GXRP flow as excluded; never impute the missing flow as zero.
Store CryptoETF's 3/5 observation as partial, with XRPZ and GXRP missing at its 05:47 UTC publication.
Do not compare CryptoETF share-creation/redemption NAV flows directly with XRP Insights holdings deltas as if they were the same measure.
Do not interpret either aggregate as confirmed open-market XRP purchases or net new external capital.
Retain per-fund provenance, universe, methodology, capture time, publication time, completeness and revision state.

Keep GXRP flow excluded until its issuer holdings history can be reconstructed without allocating the catch-up to one day.
